description: This file defines an Angular component named CoordinatesTableComponent that displays coordinate data in a table. It includes template HTML, styles, and TypeScript logic for rendering coordinate values passed via input.

classes.name: CoordinatesTableComponent
classes.description: Angular component that displays a table of coordinate values (left, top, right, bottom). It renders null if no coordinates are provided and displays the coordinate values in a styled table.

methods.name: hasCoordinates
methods.description: Checks whether any coordinate value (left, top, right, bottom) exists and should be displayed.
